state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`, Stage 3 in progress.** Stages 1 and 2 are done. ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

The error corpus is `tests/conformance/` alone: `error_corpus` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs` reads `ERROR_CORPUS_ROOT`, and `errorGaps` in `tools/nv/cmd/gaps.ts` reads `corpus(CONFORMANCE)` alone. The new test `the_error_corpus_is_the_conformance_tree_alone` holds both to it, and it reads `errorGaps`'s body to do so. After the switch, `every_error_path_is_asserted_or_declared_unreachable` lost exactly one message (`Core\Arr::countBy expected`). `tests/conformance/core/arr-count-by-throws-on-a-value-with-no-bucket.nvst` now pins it. Both tests pass.

No rule or decision record names a differential case any more. The switch pointer now names the new `tests/conformance/lang/a-switch-continue-moves-to-the-next-loop-iteration.nvst`, because no conformance case pinned a bare `continue` inside a `switch`. The clone, `static::NAME` and `::class` pointers were dropped: a conformance case already in the same list pins the same behaviour. `docs/decisions/0144.md` and `0211.md` had their *Validated by* line edited to match, the one edit the standing decisions allow. Prose elsewhere in those records, and in `docs/decisions/0023.md:261` and `docs/adr/README.md:148`, still names a differential case. Those are frozen records, so they are left as they are, but `bun nv verify --doc` may flag them once Stage 4 deletes the tree (*not checked*).

next.note: one file set: new cases under `tests/conformance/core/`, read beside the 44 `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` cases under `tests/differential/`.

items.text: **A conformance case for every divergence no conformance case pins** — goal prose § *Stage 3*, second bullet. `grep -rl -- --ORACLE-DIVERGES-- tests/differential` lists 44 cases: 43 under `core/` and `tests/differential/lang/a-negative-integer-exponent-refuses-where-php-answers-a-float.nvst:1`. Start at `tests/differential/core/arr-append-derives-the-next-free-key-where-php-remembers-it.nvst:1` and go alphabetically. For each one, check whether a conformance case for the same member already prints the same frozen output (`bun nv gaps --member 'Core\X::m'` lists them). If none does, copy the `--FILE--` into a new `tests/conformance/core/` case and freeze what `nvs test` prints. Never copy from the PHP twin. `arr-count-by-refuses-…` is done. Take the `arr-*` ones first and commit one batch at a time.
**The rest of the divergences, `csv-*` to `validate-*`** — the same check, from `tests/differential/core/csv-escape-consumes-the-byte-str_getcsv-only-stops-reading-at.nvst:1` onward.

backlog: Stage 4's runner, tree and tools — goal prose § *Stage 4*. It starts once every divergence above has its conformance case.

The frozen-record prose that names a differential case (`docs/decisions/0023.md:261`, `docs/decisions/0144.md:168`, `docs/decisions/0211.md`, `docs/adr/README.md:148`) — check it against `bun nv verify --doc` when Stage 4 deletes the tree.
